messages:
Ana: FYI — ACME (contract) just escalated. They saw 500s + model_tokenizer errors after a gradual increase in request size. @Sophie, can you share the error counts? This looks like the v2-tokenizer regression from last roll.

Sophie: Confirmed. From their logs: ~2.3% error rate over past 3h, spikes at 15:12 UTC causing timeouts. They flagged potential SLA breach if not resolved in 48h. They're asking for an interim mitigation.

Mike: Assigning to eng-platform for triage. @Jordan can you check infra saturation? I can look into model routing / pin.

Jordan: Looking now — Dedicated pool CPU/mem look fine, GPU qps slightly higher. I see OOM-ish traces in the model process (kv cache growth).

Ana: Ownership check: Mike owns model routing/pinning, Jordan owns infra scaling, I'll coordinate comms with Sophie / CSM. Agree?

Mike: Agree. Quick plan: 1) Pin ACME to model v1-quant for next 48h 2) Hotfix tokenizer regression in v2 (root cause analysis) 3) Canary v2+fix 4) Autoscale rule tweak.

Jordan: Infra steps I can do: raise Dedicated pool max burst from 400->550 for ACME tenant, enable aggressive KV truncation param. ETA 45m for config + validation.

Sophie: Please confirm messaging to ACME: we'll give them a temporary pin + expected ETA for permanent fix. They want rollback window and SLO impact.

Ana: Draft message to ACME: 'We will pin your traffic to v1-qualified model within 2h and follow up with a permanent fix ETA 48h. We'll monitor and update every 6h.' Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Mike: Sounds good. To pin we can do this curl (internal API):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/route-pin
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","model":"v1-quant","duration":"48h"}'
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
I'll run it after Jordan confirms infra.

Jordan: Confirm infra ready. I'll push KV truncation and bump burst. Running smoke tests now. If smoke passes, Mike can pin.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Started canary smoke tests for acme-route (triggered by Jordan) at 1784123500.

Jordan: Smoke looks good — 5m of steady p50/p95 under load. No error spike.

Mike: Pinning now. Running command... done. Route pinned. Monitor: p95 down from 1.8s -> 1.1s, error rate dropping.

Sophie: ACME notified. They confirmed temporary improvement but want confirmation on permanent fix timeline.

Ana: We commit to a full v2 tokenizer hotfix and canary rollout within 48h. Owner: Mike (code fix + PR), Jordan (canary infra), Ana (CS comms). Mike, can you give an ETA?

Mike: I'll open PR in 2h, aim for merge + staged canary in 24-36h. If we run into regression, we will keep pin for up to 7 days. :thumbsup:

Jordan: I'll prep rollback runbook and monitor dashboards. I'll add a temporary alert threshold for ACME route.

Sophie: Thanks team — I'll keep ACME updated and collect logs for the devs. Please ping with any blocking asks.

Ana: Thanks all. Owners logged. I'll update the incident ticket and set 6h check-ins. Closing thread unless new blockers.
